source: Nine owner-uploaded photographs IMG_9283 through IMG_9291, reviewed in chat
disclaimer: Identification supplement, not new deliveries or extra stock. Related Rev 4 groups may contain these same parts. Repeated views do not add quantities. No electrical function or optical receiver performance established.

items.name: 2N4401 NPN transistor
items.use: Warning LED output-switch candidate for B; does not complete optical detection.
items.limits: Verify exact manufacturer pinout and transistor function before wiring.

items.name: 2N4403 PNP transistor
items.use: Additional transistor stock; no assigned circuit role.
items.limits: Same part may appear in both photos; do not count twice or substitute for an NPN.

items.name: L7805CV — 5 V voltage regulator
items.use: Candidate regulator for a 5 V IR receiver supply using a suitable higher-voltage input.
items.limits: Not a working supply yet. Verify pinout, supporting capacitors, heat dissipation and loaded output. Cannot boost nominal 4.5 V to 5 V.

items.name: 10 µF, 25 V electrolytic capacitor
items.limits: Observe polarity; capacitance, leakage and condition untested. Not a substitute for every required regulator bypass capacitor.

items.name: Capacitor — value unknown ?
items.limits: Rotate to expose capacitance, voltage and polarity markings; do not assume it matches the other capacitor.

items.name: USB dongles — exact functions unknown ?
items.use: Unassigned USB accessories; no optical receiver role confirmed.
items.limits: Need labels or device identification; do not infer Wi-Fi, Bluetooth or mouse compatibility from shape.

items.name: Possible wire connectors — exact type unknown ?
items.use: Possible connection hardware after identifying openings and wire requirements.
items.limits: Inspect openings, terminal mechanism and ratings; do not classify as sensors.

items.name: Unidentified many-pin component — part number unknown ?
items.limits: Flip over and photograph all printed markings; may be another socket. No amplifier or comparator identified.

items.name: Empty IC socket
items.use: Holds a compatible IC on an appropriate assembly board.
items.limits: Not an amplifier or comparator; verify pin count and pitch.

items.name: Holder for three AAA batteries
items.use: Potential removable-cell supply and mounting base.
items.limits: Two views of the same holder. Loose/cut wires require repair, continuity, polarity and voltage checks. Series wiring and switch operation not proven; do not call it a regulated 5 V source.
